reference_clock.description: call0=B0 (native); call1=BO (native output+observation, n>=2 only); later anchors A at calls 1+k*A_period, k>=1, call<n; decision age resets at any anchor; D at a non-anchor call when (call-last_reset)>=R, else H; matched-B uses R=A_period which forces D=0.
